corrections.issue: Second half misstates the point: Beer says that if the whole space found a way to predict drawdowns and exit early, a slower replication model would capture less of the space's returns (he is skeptical it can be done); he does not say the space's returns would suffer.
corrections.fix: Predicting drawdowns in advance ('stop prevention' rather than a stop loss) is very hard and costly; if the space did learn to exit before drawdowns, a replicator that adapts only gradually would capture less of the space's returns, so Beer doubts it can be done.
